entries.headline: Cal Raleigh did not appear
entries.story: Cal Raleigh was scratched or never got in the game, so the pick carries over as a no-action.

entries.headline: Jackson Chourio came close
entries.story: Jackson Chourio went 4-for-6 with 2 RBI against Andrew Abbott and the Cincinnati Reds. Closest call was a double in the 1st: "Jackson Chourio doubles (26) on a line drive to left fielder JJ Bleday." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Pete Crow-Armstrong stayed in the yard
entries.story: Pete Crow-Armstrong went 1-for-4 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against Wilber Dotel and the Pittsburgh Pirates. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Esmerlyn Valdez stayed in the yard
entries.story: Esmerlyn Valdez went 0-for-3 against Shota Imanaga and the Chicago Cubs. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.
